question: How do I form a limited liability company, and what does it cost?

nuggets.text: One or more persons form an LLC by delivering a certificate of organization to the Mayor for filing.
nuggets.quote: (a) One or more persons may act as organizers to form a limited liability company by signing and delivering to the Mayor for filing a certificate of organization.

nuggets.text: The certificate must state the company's name and registered agent.
nuggets.quote: (b) A certificate of organization shall state: (1) The name of the limited liability company, which shall comply with §§ 29-103.01 and 29-103.02(f) ;

nuggets.text: Every entity must designate and maintain a registered agent in the District.
nuggets.quote: The following shall designate and maintain a registered agent in the District: (a) (1) A domestic filing entity;

nuggets.text: Entity filing fees (section 29-102.12) go to the Corporate Recordation Fund.
nuggets.quote: The Fund shall be credited with all fees: (1) That are identified in § 29-102.12 that are collected for Chapters 10, 12, and 13;

nuggets.text: Records are delivered to the Mayor (DLCP Corporations Division) for filing.
nuggets.quote: (2) The entity filing shall be physically delivered in written form unless and to the extent the Mayor permits electronic delivery of entity filings in other than written form.
